knowledge_review.policy: Evaluate relevant external references against local evidence; adoption is optional. Missing source detail and negative transfer remain explicit.
knowledge_review.proposal_output: Add top-level knowledge_assessments: [{knowledge_id, decision: used|considered|rejected|unresolved, rationale, transformed_mechanism, variant_names, nearest_work_difference, falsifier}]. Cover retrieved industry cards; identify the concrete changed mechanism for used cards. This is provenance, not causal proof.
knowledge_review.reflection: Review the latest knowledge-usage.json alongside outcomes; distinguish declared use, executed changes, mechanism evidence and unresolved attribution.

assessments.rationale: Resolved and read exact archived arxiv2609.16548v1 primary lines58-83, text SHA256f8e114e22e2e8016610748784b98f2ffb59e5611f92ef03689e11f7aed4de3a6. It proposes forward cross-attention query generation/multiple views in a different pCVR/capacity regime. Current observed limitation is a backward control mismatch, not demonstrated weak forward query generation. Latest usage says considered-only and no executed forward transfer; retain that distinction.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: None; forward construction, views, width and split are inherited.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Factor complete shared-row training-gradient direction/magnitude while leaving forward query construction fixed.
assessments.falsifier: This study cannot test QueryFormer transfer. A separate admitted capacity/cost-matched forward-query comparison with local diagnostics would be required.

assessments.rationale: Resolved and read archived arxiv2609.01655v1 lines55-92 and895-927 including transport description and training negative findings, text SHA256035e94708a2fd02c4910c7946cd5e8dc2da789983fe95a1aea684d348ea04f68. assessments.nearest_work_difference: Complete-row surrogate-gradient control in a fixed shallow forward rather than representation transport across blocks.
assessments.falsifier: Matched-capacity context-independent/shuffled-context forward controls would be needed to test reported transport; this backward factorial cannot confirm or refute it.

assessments.rationale: Resolved full scoped original record and reviewed observations, alternatives, negatives, limitations and next-action reserve. Independently resolved key latest receipts. New propose phase now exports source bodies and admits model code, unlike its previous analysis/query phase. Seed43/44 research execution remains unexposed. Its nearest concrete unresolved control gap is that product-role sum norm matching does not match the complete gradient. Preserve its tiny AUC gain, worse losses, degraded control and failure trajectories; do not promote its hypotheses.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: Complete-gradient direction/magnitude four-cell replacement with contemporaneous none/project bridges, instead of another donor/architecture sweep or unauthorized seed emulation. Explicit all-call energy and guard aggregates supplement its two early snapshots.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Source-audited exclusive endpoints/projection are inherited; new D/M definitions act after addition of other paths. This is a narrower raw-gradient control, not the requested future seed repetition or an Adam-update audit.
assessments.falsifier: A failed decomposition/actual-gradient/norm check defeats attribution. Null/reversed D-N/P-M weakens directional benefit. Positive one-seed performance cannot resolve independent-seed or optimizer mediation questions.

reference_format: Use allowed_observation_ids verbatim for local evidence. Descriptive references are accepted when they contain a complete known ID. Correct any previous_runtime_error before submitting; its failed costs remain charged.
action: Read candidate.py and baseline_reference.py, diagnose an observed limitation, check primary nearest work, and implement a feasible candidate. Write proposal.json containing study (matching study_schema), parent_trial (existing trial ID), and variants (1-4 objects with distinct name, file basename ending .py, role candidate/control, config object, and note). At least one candidate is required. Add key ablations or matched controls for the claimed mechanism when feasible; reference existing matched trials as controls where justified. Each variant is a standalone module. Do not run training. New architecture choices come from evidence; industry cards do not mandate them.

candidate_api.ownership: Edit or create only candidate model modules and proposal.json. No filesystem/network access from model code. Numeric imports only: torch,numpy,math,typing,copy,functools,collections,itertools,dataclasses,contextlib.
candidate_api.local_checks: Torch is not installed in the coding jail. Perform syntax/source checks there; host training and scoring follow automatically. Do not install packages or wait for human review.
candidate_api.training: from scratch; fixed host epochs, data, sample coverage, supplied history, scorer and seeds; optional optimizer/loss changes require explicit attribution controls

cards.source_problem: Heterogeneous context can destabilize the propagation of sequence and intent representations across depth.
cards.reported_mechanism: Context-conditioned residual feature transport uses reliability-aware field context to control intent/sequence updates and preserve memory paths.

reported_evidence.summary: Appendix C separates transport and distillation; Appendix F reports limited or adverse effects from added capacity and longer training. These are participant-reported contrasts.
reported_evidence.locator: craft-paper-v1, Appendix C Table 9 and Appendix F
limitations: Representation diagnostics are not a causal proof.
Local matched-cost replication and seed variation are unknown.

conditions: multiple meaningful feature groups and behavioral representations exist
representation diagnostics reveal a consequential stability or information-retention issue

transfer_risks: post-click conversion and click prediction have different labels
category/brand histories have coarser identity than richer source-domain events
more gates or capacity may explain an apparent gain
possible_discriminating_checks: measure representation norms, effective rank and field dependence
compare learned contextual modulation with equal-capacity context-independent or shuffled-context controls

retrieved_evidence.industry_relevance: matching references offered for applicability review
retrieved_evidence.adoption_policy: Retrieval is not adoption. Accept, reject or retain uncertainty with reasons; external reports do not establish local effects.

plan.question: Does the complete-shared-row magnitude intervention yield a repeatable validation AUC benefit over the unchanged-gradient control, and is any benefit specific to query/history conflict rather than generic row scaling or Adam conditioning? At seed 42, r0017-half_total_magnitude minus r0017-half_none_bridge is +0.0001774051692153833 AUC but +0.000006378891288821853 Logloss (worse); r0017-half_total_direction minus none is -0.00031232271049141946 AUC, and projection minus magnitude is -0.00008863106995493641 AUC. These observations weaken directional-benefit attribution without establishing a magnitude mechanism. First resolve the reproducibility limitation: r0017-half_project_bridge differs from r0016-half_project by +0.00006079325137475777 AUC and -0.00004412084125918203 Logloss despite equal exported configs and different source hashes. Retrieve authorized implementation and independent common-state gradient/update evidence before proposing more interventions; then prioritize a fixed four-cell paired-seed comparison if an execution interface is granted. Preserve the negative direction outcome, loss tradeoff and source-version mismatch.
missing_information: Authorized old/new projection source bodies and exact training/config/checkpoint provenance, including initialization, data order, guard definitions, decomposition and accumulation order; equal config alone does not explain bridge drift. Current workspace exports no model files or ancestor sources.

Independent common-state supervised-gradient audit of the complete shared-row sum including other paths: unchanged forward/scalar BCE; actual N/P/D/M backward; norm/direction identities; and zero padding/outside-eligible corrections. Candidate-authored snapshots and through-checkpoint summaries are supporting diagnostics, not independent verification.

Authorized common-parameter/common-moment Adam audit of actual update norms/directions and optimizer buffers. Preserving raw-gradient direction does not establish preservation of optimizer-update direction; no optimizer state is currently exported.

A permitted paired-seed execution interface for the fixed current none/project/total_direction/total_magnitude suite at seeds 43 and 44, after implementation audit. Current evidence uses seed 42 only; deterministic replays are not independent repetitions. Report every paired AUC/Logloss contrast and do not emulate new seeds through model code.

If repeatability and integrity survive, a separately admitted conflict-independent scaling replacement matched for capacity, forward, training recipe, scaling distribution and measured cost. Its design must distinguish conflict-dependent allocation from generic magnitude/conditioning effects; no such control has been executed.

Primary-source coverage for nearest gradient surgery, gradient normalization and Adam-conditioning methods.
